title: Writing / drafting
summary: A pen follows one short stroke. The ink remains visible through the action.

poses.label: Prepare
poses.direction: Focused half-lidded C eyes, short closed mouth. Small simple cyan pen and tiny outlined note at lower-right, one tiny initial ink stroke.

poses.label: Draw
poses.direction: Exact same face and rigid note. Pen tip advances along a short gently curving ink line; keep all initial ink and extend it. No letters or words.

poses.label: Finish
poses.direction: Eyes relax slightly, short restrained closed smile. Same note, pen rests at the end of the completed curved line; ink stays visible.

cycle: Prepare → draw → finish; hold finished ink, then exit before a new sheet appears.
